description:
An artist's upcoming dates on UPFRONT in one answer: every date,
venue and city, the lowest all-in price per show, and UPFRONT's
tour guide when there is one. Matches requests like "when is
Olivia Rodrigo playing near Philadelphia?", "Noah Kahan tour dates"
or "cheapest Iron Maiden show this spring", including shows across
several cities.

artist: the artist's name ("Olivia Rodrigo").
near: a place name ("Philadelphia", "Austin, TX"): only dates within
radius km (default 150) of it. lat/lng: coordinates of a location
the user has shared. Without either, the whole tour.
start_date/end_date: YYYY-MM-DD, both included; without them, every
date.
limit: how many dates to list (default 30, at most 60), soonest
first. totalDates counts every date that matched.

Each date has the event's eventId, name, venue, city, state, local
start time, fromAllInPrice and url. fromAllInPrice is the lowest
per-ticket price on UPFRONT with every fee included, as the event
page showed it at UPFRONT's last check; it is not a quote for a
number of tickets, and null means no tickets listed right now (not
sold out). url is the event's page on UPFRONT.

tourGuide, when present, is UPFRONT's guide to the tour (dates,
venues, presales, how to buy). artistPage lists every date.
otherMatches are other performers the name could mean. found false
means no artist by that name has dates in UPFRONT's catalog.
name: artist_tours
title: Tour dates and prices
